annotations.title: Upload an App Store app preview

description: Optional: the App Store doesn't require app previews, so make one only when the person wants it (ask). Uploads one app preview video (from an absolute path on this machine) to the App Store version being prepared, for one language and device size. Apple's rules, checked before anything is sent: .mov, .m4v or .mp4, H.264 (or ProRes 422 HQ in a .mov), 15 to 30 seconds, at most 30 fps and 500 MB, at most 3 per device size and language, and the device size's resolution (IPHONE_67/65/61/58: 886×1920 or 1920×886; IPHONE_55/40: 1080×1920; IPHONE_47: 750×1334; IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129/3GEN_11/105: 1200×1600; IPAD_97: 900×1200; DESKTOP, APPLE_TV: 1920×1080). Apple processes the video afterwards; ploa_listing_get shows its state. posterAt: the second shown before it plays (Apple's default is 5). Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

posterAt.description: Seconds into the video for the poster frame.
